cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - << 'EOF'
import subprocess, sys, json, time, resource, os

def run(payload):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '/workspace/submission/main.py'],
                       input=payload, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr

# empty input
rc, out, err = run(b'')
print('empty input -> rc=%d out=%r err=%r' % (rc, out, err))
assert rc == 0 and out == b'' and err == b''

# no trailing newline
rc, out, err = run(b'{"services":[],"rules":[],"queries":[]}')
print('no trailing newline -> rc=%d out=%r' % (rc, out[:60]))
assert rc == 0 and out.count(b'\n') == 1

# CRLF endings
rc, out, err = run(b'{"services":[],"rules":[],"queries":[]}\r\n{"services":["a"],"rules":[],"queries":[["a"]]}\r\n')
print('crlf -> rc=%d lines=%d' % (rc, out.count(b'\n')))
assert rc == 0 and out.count(b'\n') == 2
for line in out.decode().splitlines():
    assert line.startswith('{"ok":true')

# blank line in the middle
rc, out, err = run(b'\n{"services":[],"rules":[],"queries":[]}\n\n')
print('blank lines -> rc=%d lines=%d' % (rc, out.count(b'\n')))
assert rc == 0 and out.count(b'\n') == 3

# 8 heavy lines (timing / memory)
import random
rng = random.Random(5)
svc = ['t%d'%i for i in range(24)]
lines = []
for i in range(8):
    specs = [tuple(rng.choice(svc) for _ in range(4)) for _ in range(10)]
    when = {'op':'and','args':[{'op':'contains','path':list(p)} for p in specs]}
    lines.append(json.dumps({'services':svc,'rules':[{'action':'allow','when':when}],
                             'queries':[[svc[0],svc[1]]]}))
payload = ('\n'.join(lines) + '\n').encode()
print('payload %.2f MB' % (len(payload)/1e6))
t0 = time.time()
rc, out, err = run(payload)
el = time.time() - t0
print('8 heavy -> rc=%d out=%.1f MB elapsed=%.2fs err=%r' % (rc, len(out)/1e6, el, err[:100]))
assert rc == 0 and out.count(b'\n') == 8

# max query sizes
q = {'services':['a','b'],
     'rules':[{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'contains','path':['a','b','a']}}],
     'queries':[['a','b']*2048, ['a']*4096, ['b']*4096, []]}
payload = (json.dumps(q) + '\n').encode()
t0 = time.time()
rc, out, err = run(payload)
print('max queries -> rc=%d elapsed=%.2fs out=%r' % (rc, time.time()-t0, out[:80]))
assert rc == 0
EOF
